teams.heading: Jake White names four uncapped Fiji players for Saturday's Japan Test
teams.body: Jake White's first Fiji squad for the Japan Test has four uncapped players, with Nacani Boginisoko and Aporosa Vuniyayawa both starting. Peni Naruma and Kavekini Boselawa could win their debuts off the bench, and Isaiah Armstrong-Ravula starts at fly-half with Tevita Ikanivere captaining. It is the first time the sides have met since Japan beat Fiji 20-15 in September's Pacific Nations Cup final, and the test opens preparation for November's Nations Championship matches against France, Ireland and Italy.

lead.why: The newest item in the pack and the men's national squad selection for the Japan Test, with four uncapped players named.

teams.body: England's Seb Atkinson is out of Gloucester's West Country derby against Bath, ruled out through injury along with Wales' Dewi Lake. Gloucester head coach George Skivington has still named a strong side, with Jac Morgan taking over the captaincy from Lake. Gloucester go into the clash top of the PREM on 12 points, with Bath one behind on 11. Borthwick names his training squad on Sunday for the November Nations Championship matches.

teams.heading: Galthié calls up South African-born Jeremy Ward despite France's injury crisis
teams.body: Fabien Galthié has named Jeremy Ward, a South African-born Stade Français player, in France's 42-man squad for the November Nations Championship matches, even as the coach works through a growing injury list. Ward, a former Junior Springboks captain, cannot play for France until residency rules allow next year, so his call-up is for training purposes, reports say. It comes as Ramos, Jalibert, Marchand and Meafou are all sidelined, with Nicolas Depoortere dropped to make room.

lead.why: It is a men's national-squad selection story with a genuine shock element, and it reshapes the squad during an injury crisis.

teams.heading: Jamie Benson earns Ireland call-up for autumn tests after Ulster move
teams.body: Ireland coach Andy Farrell's squad for the autumn internationals, named on Wednesday, includes Ulster's Jamie Benson, who joined the province from Harlequins over the summer. Benson previously played for England up to U20 level, but he could now wear green at test level, and his call-up comes only a few months after his move to Ulster.

teams.heading: Former Scotland winger Tim Visser to stand trial on rape charges
teams.body: Former Scotland winger Tim Visser is to go on trial accused of controlling, abusing and raping a woman. The 39-year-old, who won 33 caps for Scotland, faces four charges covering alleged incidents in Edinburgh, Surrey and the Netherlands over 14 years, two of them alleging rape, including one claiming he had sex with her after consent was withdrawn. A further charge alleges he took intimate images of her without consent. The trial will be held in Edinburgh.

Gloucester go into the clash top of the PREM on 12 points, with Bath one behind on 11.

teams.heading: World Rugby names Pierre Brousset to referee Wallabies' Test against England
teams.body: World Rugby has named France's Pierre Brousset to referee the Wallabies' next Test, away to England at Allianz Stadium in London. Australia's stake is pointed: former captain Michael Hooper has already criticised Andrea Piardi over the Perth Test against South Africa, in which the Wallabies were reduced to 11 men after four sin-binnings. Piardi has been given France v South Africa in the November window, and Brousset now takes charge of a match that will shape Australia's standing after back-to-back Bledisloe defeats.

lead.why: It is the strongest new angle on Australia's next Test, with two outlets carrying the referee story and a direct link to the Hooper criticism of Piardi.

teams.heading: Warner Deans back from injury as Japan host Fiji in centenary match
teams.body: Japan's Warner Deans is back from injury for Saturday's JRFU 100th Anniversary Match against Fiji, with training camps also seeing the return of props Yota Kamimori and Keijiro Tamesawa and fly-half Shinya Komura. Fiji, now coached by Jake White, have four uncapped players in their squad, three of them in the starting XV: Aporosa Vuniyayawa, Nacani Boginisoko and Peni Naruma. Japan beat Fiji 20-15 in the Pacific Nations Cup final in September, a result that put them into the World Rugby top ten.

lead.why: It is a men's 15s story with a Saturday fixture and a returning player, and it is new today, unlike the sevens and Kwagga Smith items already run.

teams.heading: Brodie Retallick rules out All Blacks return while overseas policy stands
teams.body: Brodie Retallick has closed the door on an All Blacks return, telling the Sportscafe Legends podcast the Kobe Steelers lock will not be considered for Test rugby. "Until they change the rules, it's not even a possibility, so I'm not even going to entertain it," said the 35-year-old, who is playing in Japan with two seasons left on his Kobe contract. Head coach Dave Rennie had been open about wanting him back, but Retallick's last Test was the 2023 World Cup final.

lead.why: It is the freshest new item about a New Zealand men's Test-availability question, and it is a firm answer rather than a rumour.

teams.heading: Jean Kleyn targets Springbok recall from Gloucester form before Monday squad
teams.body: Gloucester lock Jean Kleyn says his strong start at Kingsholm could earn a Springbok recall, with Rassie Erasmus due to name the autumn Nations Championship squad on Monday. The 33-year-old missed the southern hemisphere leg after rupturing a biceps tendon in April, and Gloucester currently top the Premiership table. "I'd love to be involved this autumn," he said. Kleyn won five Test caps for Ireland before switching to South Africa and making his Springbok debut in 2023.

lead.why: A fresh selection storyline on the men's Springboks, with the squad announcement due Monday.
